methodology.timing: One full synchronous transaction per real requestAnimationFrame callback; warmup excluded. Closure setup, checksum and UI outside timed callback work.
methodology.frames: Callback scripting and consecutive rAF timestamp intervals, not a browser tracing total-frame or paint-latency measurement. No framework DOM bindings exist yet.
methodology.ordering: One isolated headless Chrome process/tab for all trials; engine order rotates by round. No forced GC.
methodology.memory: Chromium performance.memory before/after observations; neither exact allocation nor retained heap. Browser GC pause API unavailable; Node profiles separately supply GC observations.
methodology.environment: Headless Chrome with foreground/visibility checks and explicit flags. Desktop browsers/displays may differ.
